This '''particular model''' of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
The class appeared to be a hybrid of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] and the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] Star Destroyers, but was smaller than both and had a visual protrusion at the bow. It also bore certain similarities to the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class ships]], one of the earliest iterations of the Star Destroyer archetype. Notably, the design had armor that could extend and retract around the vessel itself. A small [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] was located on the top of the ship's bow.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>

It was equipped with four main engines that were of a similar design to the engines of the ''Venator''-class. It also shared the characteristic arrow-shaped command tower of the ''Venator''-class.

It was armed with six [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser towers]] lined up in threes along the ship's dorsal hull and a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser turret]] located in the center of its dorsal hull.
==History==
Multiple of these transports were present at the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] above [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] [[Kota's Militia|militia]] forces attacked sometime around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].
[[File:ShCorridor.png|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial Heavy Transport in a [[shield corridor]]]]
[[Desolation Station transport|A ship]] of this class was used to ferry [[Tributary beam|tributary]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlasers]] and other newly assembled components from [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Despayre|construction site]]. These components were transferred to the ship via [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] while it sat safely within a [[shield corridor]]. During an [[Mission to Desolation Station|attack]] on the station by [[X2]] and a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] operatives, X2 infiltrated the station, disabled the shield corridor, and used a stole [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] to neutralize the ship's weaponry before landing in its hangar. He fought his way to the weapons control room where he activated the backwards-facing superlaser to destroy Desolation Station.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron2">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>  

==Behind the Scenes==
In the game files of ''The Force Unleashed'', these ships are referred to as "ImpHeavyTrans," meaning Imperial Heavy Transport. They are briefly glimpsed throughout scenes of the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|space battle]] around the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]]. Given this file name, the function of each vessel type and the extensive visual similarities, at least in regard to the in-game model, it is possible that these ships are refitted ''Venators''.<ref name="Model">{{WebCite|url=https://imgur.com/a/LQ1PiYI|text=Nar Shaddaa Star Destroyer/"ImpHeavyTrans" model documentation|date=2025-0-19|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/nHkok}}</ref>

A ship identical to the one depicted in ''The Force Unleashed'' appears in the Nintendo DS version of ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron|Battlefront: Elite Squadron]].''<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron3">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>
